pages.text: The winged sandals of Hermes: speed, high jumps and no fall damage. Look in the cloud shrines and temples, or make them: harpy feathers, gold and golden boots.
The Titan's breastplate: strength, resistance and a firm stance. Found in cyclops caves and the labyrinth, or made from an orichalcum chestplate, orichalcum, a cyclops eye and a hydra scale.
